description: CAGR Calculator with a chart, the same math as the web page. How fast did it grow each year? CAGR means compound annual growth rate. It is the one steady rate a year that takes your start value to your end value. It finds the one steady yearly rate that turns the start value into the end value over the years you type. It does not show how the value moved in between, only one steady rate. People ask for it as "cagr calculator", "how to calculate cagr" or "what is my yearly growth rate".

end.description: Value at the end. US dollars. Default: 15000.

start.description: Value at the start. US dollars. Default: 10000.

years.description: Number of years. In years. 2.5 is fine. Default: 5.
